answer: Sybils must split capital across many keys, so raising N fake identities costs N times the stake plus per-vertex verification fees. Each agent must stake tokens at a unique verified vertex of the identity graph, binding stake to a distinct biometric-anchored key. A cheap signal like a tundra-cold wallet with no history is ignored; only aged, staked vertices earn weight. Faking influence thus costs linearly in stake, making large-scale sybil farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
